item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Title on the cover page illegible in the reproduction.
Miniatures left and right on fol. 1b.
Interlinear and marginal annotations.
Proofread twice (2 zhus dag go).
Annotations by several hands on the last folio, some of which are writing exercises.
